title: 多益測驗
description: 模擬多益聽力與閱讀題型

options: (A) People are walking in an office building
(B) A meeting is starting in the conference room
(C) Employees are working at their desks
(D) Someone is presenting to a group
questions.explanation: 圖片中顯示人們在辦公大樓走動。

options: (A) The plane is arriving at the gate
(C) Luggage is being loaded onto the plane
questions.explanation: 圖片中顯示行李正在被裝載到飛機上。

questions.question: Could you please send me the report by Friday?
options: (C) The report is on the desk
questions.explanation: 這是一個請求問題，正確回應應該是接受或拒絕請求。

questions.question: Where is the marketing department?
questions.explanation: 詢問地點，應該回答具體位置。

questions.dialogue:
M: Hi Sarah, did you finish the presentation?
W: Almost, I need to add some charts to make it more convincing.
M: Great, let me know when it's ready.
questions.question: What does the man want Sarah to do?
questions.explanation: 男子想知道 Sarah 何時完成簡報。

questions.dialogue: Welcome to City Library. Our hours are from 9 AM to 9 PM on weekdays, and 10 AM to 6 PM on weekends. Please note that the computer lab will be closed for maintenance next Monday.
questions.question: When will the computer lab be closed?
questions.explanation: 獨白提到 'next Monday' 下週一。

questions.question: Please let me know if you ____ any questions.
questions.explanation: if 引導的條件句，使用現在式。

questions.question: The meeting ____ scheduled for 3 PM.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 'meeting'，第三人稱單數，使用 is。

questions.question: She ____ working here since 2020.
questions.explanation: since + 時間點，使用完成式 'has been'。

questions.dialogue:
Dear Mr. Smith,

Thank you for your inquiry about our products. I ____ (1) pleased to provide you with the information you requested.

Our company ____ (2) established in 1995. We specialize in manufacturing high-quality electronics.
questions.explanation: 第一題主詞是 I，用 am。第二題描述過去成立的公司，用 was。

questions.dialogue:
From: John Davis <john.davis@company.com>
To: All Employees
Subject: Office Relocation

Dear Colleagues,

Our office will be moving to a new location on December 1st. Please pack your belongings by November 25th. The new address will be 123 Business Park, Suite 500.

Best regards,
John Davis

questions.question: When must employees pack their belongings?
What is the purpose of this email?

questions.explanation: 這是一封辦公室搬遷通知郵件。
